title: work-source register-report
description: The stage-report a work source registers (the report field of a register request): the stage-report of the worker without status, questions, review_recommendation and self_check. Closed: a field the source does not record would be lost. The rules a schema cannot state are checked in code (orch.worksource_report.report_semantics, the check_report of the planner bridge): the ids of checks_run are unique, and every text keeps a character after Unicode whitespace is stripped.

summary.description: What changed and why, in a few lines.

changed_paths.description: Every repository path created, modified or deleted.

checks_run.description: Checks that actually ran; an id appears once.

evidence.description: Paths of output files and evidence documents.

open_issues.description: Every surprise that matters to the plan, classified.

text.description: Text with at least one non-whitespace character.

check.description: A command check with its exit, or a manual procedure with its verdict.

cmd.description: Command as written in the input.

procedure.description: Procedure as written in the input.

issue.description: One open issue; its kind decides what the source records.

class.description: Class of a deviation: what it deviates from.

outcome.description: How the deviation ends: accepted as is, a follow-up for later work, or a decision of the owner.

auto_fixable.description: True when the deviation can be repaired without a decision.

evidence.description: Where it shows: path:line or a check id V<n>; when present, not empty.

items.description: A path:line or a check id.
